Phoenix found more than one copy of its local database and could not tell safely which one to keep, so it stopped before opening either. Nothing was deleted. Export the database files to keep a copy, then email them privately to support@phoenix-portal.com with the diagnostic and support codes below. The files contain your workout history, so do not attach them to a public issue. Retry checks again once support has helped you resolve the duplicate.
